title: Model supply-chain attestation and automated restricted-weights flagging
creator: Maya Chen
description: Add an automated attestation pipeline and restricted-weight detection to the model onboarding flow so that every uploaded model artifact is evaluated for license compatibility, provenance of weights, and risk flags before it becomes available in the catalog. This ticket covers the product requirements and rollout plan: 1) automated SPDX license parsing + heuristics for custom licences, 2) weight provenance checks (hash matching, declared source registry), 3) restricted-weights flagging against a maintained denylist and embargo list, 4) human review/override UI with audit trail, 5) connector for external attestation providers (optional), and 6) publish a compliance-ready performance profile only after gating conditions are satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Uploaded model package triggers license parsing and returns SPDX/closest-match with confidence score
Weight artifact hash is verified against declared source URL or registry manifest when available
If weight hash or license matches a denylist/embargo entry the model is automatically flagged and cannot be published
UI shows a single-reviewer workflow: attestation details, automated checks, and a single button to approve/deny with reason
Performance profile publishing is blocked until the model's compliance state is APPROVED or overridden by a designated legal reviewer
Event emitted to observability stream with compliance verdicts for telemetry and audit logs
tasks: Design SPDX-first parser and fallback heuristics for non-SPDX license text (ENG + Legal)
Define schema for weight provenance: declared_source, artifact_hash, manifest_url, signature (ENG)
Implement denylist/embargo store and periodic sync with threat intel/legal inputs (ENG)
Build gating logic in onboarding backend to set compliance_state and block catalog publish (ENG)
Design and ship reviewer UI in Console with audit trail and reason capture (DES + ENG)
Add telemetry events and dashboard for compliance failures and manual overrides (ENG + Observability)
Integration tests covering positive/negative license matches, hash mismatches, and manual approvals (QA)
Legal review and SLAs for exception approvals and retention policy for audit logs (PM + Legal)
decisions: Use SPDX as primary canonicalizer for license text; fall back to fuzzy matching and manual legal review for uncommon texts
Start with a managed denylist maintained by Legal and Product; later expose an enterprise allowlist/denylist override for Private deployments
Weight signature verification optional in v1; require hash+manifest verification and surface signature as a recommended best-practice
Performance profile publishing will be decoupled from onboarding acceptance to allow internal validation runs, but blocked for external catalog visibility until compliance approved
